summary: MVA Bennett is a Melbourne CBD chartered accounting and audit firm (est. 1941) in the Walker Wayland network, grown through mergers including JT&P in 2023. Travis Fegan is Managing Partner and recently shared the firm's journey with Walker Wayland members. An internal innovation team is working on an AI-driven strategy and the firm is hiring a Business Services Manager. Travis and Chris Hall were both emailed on 23 Nov 2026.

hooks.text: Travis recently opened up about the firm's journey, decisions and challenges to Walker Wayland peers, and has a CFO-in-a-family-business background: receptive to practical operating-model talk.
Innovation team is already designing an AI-driven strategy and the firm is hiring a Business Services Manager to improve operational efficiency: reconciliation automation fits both.
vCFO offering built on technology-driven efficiency, plus outsourced capacity, means recurring reconciliation volume.

risks.text: Both Travis and Chris Hall were emailed on 23 Nov 2026; keep follow-ups to one thread each and do not double up.
Firm is audit and tax led (weak bookkeeping fit per record); in-house AI strategy may mean they build rather than buy.
Andrew Ellem (former Managing Partner) left in July 2025 and is flagged do-not-contact; the firm's team page still lists him, so treat it as stale.

Xero or other tech stack at firm level not confirmed (job ad only mentions Xero).
